user_saw: Pressing Ctrl+C during `openclaw channels list` left the CLI waiting about two seconds (until the cleanup deadline killed it) or printed a late fallback account list after the interrupt.
summary: Passed the CLI async-work abort signal into the channels.status Gateway read in `channels list` and rethrew the abort instead of falling back to the command-local account list.
reasoning: GraphQL blame puts readGatewayChannelStatus and its signal-less callGateway call in b672be59ae46 (#82016, May 2026), while the CLI work-scope abort signal (src/shared/async-work-scope.ts, first seen 0d830e9e, Sept 2026) and the cooperative SIGINT barrier came later, so the read could not have honored a signal that did not exist when it was written. The fault became visible once the CLI began waiting for in-flight work on SIGINT and commands were expected to honor getAsyncWorkSignal; no single in-repo commit was confirmed as the exposing trigger, so trigger_sha is left null. The sibling fix for channels status (#196976) is the same class.
